title: Top 3 Entry Espresso Machines Under $300 (2026 Guide)
summary: Can you pull genuine 9-bar espresso without spending a fortune? We bench tested 12 entry-level espresso machines.
body:
Entering the home espresso hobby used to require an investment of at least $1,000. Fortunately, thermoblock technology and pressurized portafilters have made real 9-bar extraction achievable for under $300.

1. De'Longhi Dedica Deluxe EC680

With its ultra-compact 6-inch width, the Dedica reaches brewing temperature in under 40 seconds.

title: Burr Grinder vs. Blade Grinder: The Untold Truth
summary: Why your grinder matters far more than your espresso machine for dialing in rich microfoam shots.
body: If you split your espresso budget 50/50 between machine and grinder, you will get significantly better espresso.
